bio: Karven Wu is a Mortgage Agent Level 1 (licence M23008143) with Caliber Mortgage, based in Richmond Hill, Ontario. The site cites over five years in financial services and nearly five as a licensed agent, and covers first-time buyers, refinance, residential, private and alternative mortgages. It promotes a free mortgage app, flat legal fees and a Home Buyer Helper, and a realtor partnership message. Market focus is Toronto and the GTA.
